description: Defines abstract interfaces for non-blocking audio I/O components in Android, including port, sink, and source classes with negotiation, data transfer, and timestamp functionalities.

classes.name: NBAIO_Port
classes.description: Abstract interface for a data port used in audio I/O negotiation and format management.

classes.name: NBAIO_Sink
classes.description: Abstract interface for a non-blocking audio data sink for data providers.

classes.name: NBAIO_Source
classes.description: Abstract interface for a non-blocking audio data source for data consumers.

methods.name: negotiate
methods.description: Checks compatibility of formats between data port endpoints, possibly exchanging offers and counter-offers.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Returns the current negotiated format or Format_Invalid if not negotiated.

methods.name: framesWritten
methods.description: Returns the number of frames successfully written since creation.

methods.name: framesUnderrun
methods.description: Returns the number of frames lost due to underrun since creation.

methods.name: underruns
methods.description: Returns the number of underrun events since creation.

methods.name: availableToWrite
methods.description: Estimates how many frames can be written without blocking.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Transfers data to the sink from a buffer.

methods.name: writeVia
methods.description: Transfers data to the sink using callbacks for non-contiguous or zero-fill transfers.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves a timestamp of the presentation count and clock time.

methods.name: framesRead
methods.description: Returns the number of frames read since creation.

methods.name: framesOverrun
methods.description: Returns the number of frames lost due to overrun since creation.

methods.name: overruns
methods.description: Returns the number of overrun events since creation.

methods.name: availableToRead
methods.description: Estimates how many frames can be read without blocking.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Transfers data from the source into a buffer.

methods.name: readVia
methods.description: Transfers data from the source using callbacks for non-contiguous or zero-fill transfers.
